brief: A planter of four cells with a water pipe running through the bases to feed every cell.

requirements.evidence: Four full hex bases in a straight row at axial (-1,0), (0,0), (1,0), (2,0), each holding a third-depth drained pill-hole bin (hex-bin-third-drain-pill) with soil and a plant (basil, mint, thyme, parsley). check_build: meshClash clear, no rule errors.

requirements.requirement: A water pipe running through the bases
requirements.evidence: One run (run-1) starts at (-1,0) entering from edge 3 and passes straight through (0,0), (1,0) and (2,0), so the pipe runs through all four bases in the row. Note: the run's MESH_NOT_RUN warning was raised on add; check_build still reports meshClash clear.

The pipe passes through every cell's base, and each cell has a bin. The configurator checks fit and collisions only, not whether water actually flows into each bin; the bins are the pill-hole drained type, and I did not configure any inlet/port connection between the pipe and each bin.

requirements.requirement: Water-tightness / material suitability for watering (food, waterproofing, UV, strength)
requirements.evidence: The configurator does not model materials, waterproofing or safety; these depend on the material the user prints in and were not verified.

finish.summary: Built a four-cell planter: four hex bases in a row, each with a third-depth drained bin planted with herbs, and a single pipe run threaded straight through all four bases. check_build is clear (meshClash clear, no rule errors). Feed-to-each-cell is only shown by the pipe passing through each base; I did not add separate ports to each bin. Material and watertightness are not checked by the configurator.

lines.label: Bin, third depth, drained, pill holes

notes: 1 run IRRIGATION: non-potable supply. Corners are flexible hose, glued into Sch 40 sockets, one coupling wherever hose meets rigid pipe.
cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes
